frozen_note: Chosen after cyl2d_contract.json was frozen (9d53cd1, formula corrected ddc7095) and before any cylinder run, including timing runs. Never widened after a result; a FAIL is kept.
source: Qu et al. 2013 Table 2 (Re 100), re-read with pdftotext from the primary PDF sha256 1a67139ea4d70d4149a66506c663e185ed927c48bd4a4396cdb13270fc30c73b

half_width_derivation.rule: sum of Qu's own documented sensitivities, each as max |change| / reference: grid (D5-D8 vs D2) + time step (D9-D11 vs D2) + domain (D4 vs D1, H 60 vs H 200); rounded up to 0.1 %
half_width_derivation.domain_term_role: stands in for the unquantified difference between our free-slip lateral faces and Qu's free-stream lateral condition. That is our inference: Qu did not test lateral condition type

not_covered_by_the_source: WaterLily's own discretisation error (uniform Cartesian h = D/32, D/64 with BDIM, vs Qu's body-fitted 0.0054 D wall cell). The band is what the reference supports, not what this solver is expected to reach. A FAIL is a plausible, informative outcome (the 3-D sphere C1 read ~16-20 % low).

pass_rule.R2_fidelity: R2 Cd, Cd_p and St each within half_width of the H60 reference, with a periodic state (contract)
pass_rule.grid_pair: |Cd(R2) - Cd(R1)| / Cd(R2) <= 0.03 (ENGINEERING assumption, not from the source); reported for St and Cd_p too
pass_rule.mutant: M1 (Re 25) must NOT satisfy the R2 fidelity rule; a missing periodic state counts as not satisfying it
pass_rule.domain_diagnostic: R3 compared with the H120 reference and with R1; reported, not required to pass
pass_rule.surface_internal: |Cd_p_surface / Cd_p - 1| <= 0.10 on R2 (ENGINEERING tolerance for internal consistency, not a validation)
control_passes_only_if: periodic state in R1, R2 and R3
pass_rule.consequence_of_fail: physical-fidelity wording for any 2-D fin section stays blocked; the sections may still run as labelled model diagnostics (claude-07 protocol)
